package main

import (
 "context"
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "runtime"
 "testing"
 jt "github.com/mellowforge/jsontrans-go"
 js "github.com/mellowforge/jsontrans-go/javascript"
)

func TestMonitorDiagnostic(t *testing.T) {
 dir:=os.Getenv("JSONTRANS_MEMORY_DIAGNOSTICS");if dir=="" {t.Fatal("JSONTRANS_MEMORY_DIAGNOSTICS is required")}
 prior:=runtime.GOMAXPROCS(1);defer runtime.GOMAXPROCS(prior)
 buf:=make([]byte,1<<20)
 for cycle:=1;cycle<=10;cycle++ {
  e,err:=js.New(context.Background(),js.Config{GuestMemoryBytes:64<<20});if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
  p,err:=e.Compile(context.Background(),`()=>42`);if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
  if _,err=p.Eval(context.Background(),nil,jt.EvalOptions{});err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
  if err=e.Close();err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
  n:=runtime.Stack(buf,true)
  if n==len(buf) {t.Fatal("stack buffer truncated")}
  if err=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir,fmt.Sprintf("stacks-%02d.txt",cycle)),buf[:n],0600);err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
 }
}
